title: Pure Maju
summary: An explosive banish-beatdown OTK build centered around Gren Maju Da Eiza alongside Great Maju Garzett, Legendary Maju Garzett, and mass self-banishers. Every banished card gives Gren Maju Da Eiza 400 ATK and DEF, turning a single Level 3 Normal Summon into an 8,000+ ATK finisher.

summary.title: Banish Engines & Enablers
points: Pot of Desires banishes 10 cards from the top of your Deck face-down to draw 2 cards, immediately granting Gren Maju Da Eiza 4000 ATK and DEF.
Gizmek Orochi, the Serpentron Sky Slasher banishes the top 8 cards of your Deck face-down as a Quick Effect from the hand or GY to Special Summon itself (+3200 ATK to Gren Maju).
Eater of Millions banishes 5 or more cards from your Extra Deck face-down to Special Summon itself (+2000 to +6000 ATK to Gren Maju) and banishes any monster it battles face-down.
Allure of Darkness banishes Necroface from your hand to draw 2 cards and banish 5 more cards from the top of both players' Decks.

summary.title: Opening & OTK Line
steps: Start Main Phase 1 with Pot of Extravagance or activate Pot of Desires and Allure of Darkness to load 10 to 20+ cards into your banishment.
Special Summon Gizmek Orochi, the Serpentron Sky Slasher by banishing 8 more cards and Eater of Millions by banishing spare Extra Deck cards.
Normal Summon Gren Maju Da Eiza with 8,000 to 12,000+ ATK, or Tribute a high-ATK monster for Great Maju Garzett or Legendary Maju Garzett to swing for game.

summary.title: The Maju Garzett Lineup
summary.text: While Gren Maju Da Eiza scales off your banished cards, the Maju Garzett Fiends multiply your board's raw ATK: Great Maju Garzett gains twice the original ATK of the 1 monster Tributed for its summon (turning Gizmek Orochi into a 4900 ATK attacker), Legendary Maju Garzett Tributes all monsters you control to gain their combined original ATK with piercing damage, and Maju Garzett combines the ATK of two Tributes.

summary.title: Control & Extra Deck
points: Dimensional Fissure and Macro Cosmos banish every monster or card sent to the GY, shutting down opposing graveyard strategies while continuously boosting Gren Maju Da Eiza.

Level 8 Gizmek Orochi and Legendary Maju Garzett overlay into Rank 8 Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star for non-targeting removal or Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy for Spell negation.
Level 1 Eater of Millions links into Relinquished Anima to absorb an opponent's monster pointed to by its arrow.

allow.Pot of Desires: Banishes 10 cards from the top of your Deck face-down to draw 2 cards—immediately giving Gren Maju Da Eiza +4000 ATK and DEF!
allow.Pot of Extravagance: Banishes 6 random face-down cards from your Extra Deck at the start of Main Phase 1 to draw 2 cards and give Gren Maju Da Eiza +2400 ATK.
allow.Macro Cosmos: Continuous Trap that banishes every card sent to the GY, fueling Gren Maju Da Eiza while shutting down the opponent's graveyard.
allow.Dimensional Fissure: Continuous Spell that banishes any monster sent to the GY, continuously boosting Gren Maju Da Eiza.
allow.Necroface: Level 4 Zombie that shuffles all banished cards back into the Deck on Normal Summon, OR banishes the top 5 cards of BOTH Decks whenever it is banished!
allow.Allure of Darkness: Draws 2 cards and banishes a DARK monster (like Necroface, triggering 10 more banished cards, or Gizmek Orochi!).
allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 Xyz summoned using Level 8 Gizmek Orochi and Legendary Maju Garzett.
allow.Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star: Rank 8 Xyz summoned using Level 8 Gizmek Orochi and Legendary Maju Garzett for non-targeting removal.
allow.Relinquished Anima: Link-1 summoned using Level 1 Eater of Millions to absorb an opponent's monster.
